# Test Fixture Manifest

This file tracks every file under `tests/fixtures/` used in automated tests.
It records the source, licence, expected properties, and acquisition date for each fixture.

> [!CAUTION]
> **No real user photographs may be committed to version control.**
> All fixtures must be public domain, CC0, or carry explicit written permission
> for use in automated testing and version control.

---

## Adding New Fixtures

When adding a new fixture:

1. Confirm licence is public domain, CC0, or written permission.
2. Add a row to this manifest with all fields filled.
3. Store the fixture file in `tests/fixtures/`.
4. The `.gitignore` exception `!tests/fixtures/*.jpg` allows committed fixtures.
5. Run the full test suite before committing.
